55021.notes: Wisconsin in-rem tax foreclosure county. Columbia County Treasurer (Portage) sells tax-delinquent foreclosure properties by blind sealed bid after foreclosure, not a live courthouse outcry. Notices publish in the Portage Daily Register and on the county Land Sales page. Minimum bid equals appraised value; county may accept or reject any bid; bidders currently owing Columbia delinquent taxes are disqualified. Quitclaim deed after full payment. Distinct from weekly Sheriff mortgage foreclosure sales at the courthouse (Ch. 846) — those are not the tax-foreclosure land-sale track. Madison–Portage I-39/90/94 corridor market (Portage, Lodi, Poynette, Columbus).

Bid must meet at least the published minimum (appraisal). Earnest money: certified check, cashier's check, money order, or cash equal to 10% of the bid, accompanying the bid. Balance due within 30 days of the County's Notice of Acceptance or earnest money is forfeited. Rejected-bid earnest money returned within 15 days of bid opening.

45021.notes: South Carolina redeemable tax-deed county. Cherokee County Delinquent Tax Office (Gaffney) runs an annual public auction at 110 Railroad Ave after execution, seizure, and three consecutive weekly newspaper ads. Opening bid is submitted for the Forfeited Land Commission equal to all delinquent taxes, penalties, costs, plus current-year taxes. Registration is online-only and must be redone every year (2025 cycle: last registration day Dec 4, 2025; sale historically early December — e.g. Dec 8, 2025). 12-month statutory redemption with tiered interest (3%/6%/9%/12% by quarter). Do not confuse with Cherokee County, TX (mvbataxsales listings) or Cherokee County, NC judicial foreclosures.
